translation.name: Xchiʼdxyi cuubi dxiohs nin bieʼgaluuʼyi daada Jesucristu (El Nuevo Testamento en el zapoteco de Chichicapan y en español)

book.name: San Lucas
book.title: Dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ nin bacaꞌh San Lucas xcweenta Jesucristu

content: Gwah Jesuhs rwaaꞌ yihdzi tuhbi bwiinn nin laa Zaqueu
Ya chin badzihn Jesuhs rwaaꞌ guihdxyi Jericoh, gudiiꞌdxi Ñiꞌh galaayi guihdxyi chi.
Guihdxyi chi gahca nuu tuhbi bwiinn nin laa Zaqueu; rricu duxa ba, rnabwaꞌ ba bwiinn raꞌ nin rusadxihlli impweestu.
Ya guclaaꞌdzi ba dxiuꞌnbwaꞌ ba laꞌh Jesuhs, per ayi guhca ñwaꞌha ba laꞌh Jesuhs laasii rii ziahanrooꞌ bwiinn gadiidxi coma Zaqueu bwiinnllaꞌta ba.
Lwehgu balluꞌn ba gwah ba delaanta hasta zohba tuhbi llaaꞌn yahga gurooꞌ nin laa sicohmoro nez tiidxi Jesuhs, chiꞌchi gucah ba lohon tin guhca bwaꞌha ba laꞌh Jesuhs.
Ya chin guyaꞌloh gudiiꞌdxi Jesuhs riꞌchi bwaꞌha Ñiꞌh nez guiyaꞌ, chiꞌchi rahbi Ñiꞌh loh Zaqueu: ―Zaqueu, basiooba bieꞌta riꞌca tin nnadxyih gahca nahpa chadxiaꞌhnahn yihdzi luꞌh.
Chiꞌchi bieꞌtagalluꞌn Zaqueu loh yahga chi tin zenee ba laꞌh Jesuhs par yihdzi ba, riahxi ba.
Ya chin bwaꞌha snuhn bwiinn niꞌchi guzaꞌloh cañiꞌ tohnta raꞌ ba, rahbi raꞌ ba: ―Bwaꞌha laꞌJesuhs zedxiaꞌhan rwaaꞌ yihdzi bwiinn nin mahzi nahpa duhlda.

Chiꞌchi guzuꞌnchii Zaqueu delaanta loh Jesuhs, rahbi ba: ―Bwaꞌha Daada; gudiꞌhihn garoolda nin naꞌpahn guicaꞌha raꞌ bwiinn prohbi, ya sidela gulaꞌnaꞌhn laꞌh chyuulla cun guelrsaguiꞌhi nnah gusiaꞌgariin xmweeyi ba tahpa taantu pur nin basaguiꞌhihn laꞌh ba.
Chiꞌchi rahbi Jesuhs loh ba: ―Nnadxyih gahca laꞌxtuhlda luꞌh basiaꞌpitiin neezaa xtuhlda bwiinn raꞌ nin nuu yihdzi luꞌh gusiaꞌpitiiñin laasii guchii luꞌh naa luꞌh xpwiinn guehtu Abrahn,
laasii naꞌh naan Lliiꞌn Dxiohs nin naa ndxiꞌhw tin chiꞌhyihn bwiinn raꞌ nin cagañihchi pur xtuhlda raꞌ ba tin naꞌh guhldaꞌhraꞌn ba loh xtuhlda raꞌ ba.
Cweenta xteenn tsiꞌh mweeyi

Ya gaduhbi rigacaꞌdxiahga raꞌ bwiinn dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ nin cañiꞌ Jesuhs, bwiiꞌyidxyiꞌdxyi lagaꞌh Ñiꞌh stuhbi cweenta loh raꞌ ba laasii laꞌ raꞌ ba zeegadzihn gahxula guihdxyi Jerusalehn nen coma laꞌh raꞌ ba ruhnn raꞌ ba lligaaba lwehgu saꞌloh guinabwaꞌ Jesuhs laasii laꞌ raꞌ ba gadzihnla guihdxyi Jerusalehn,

chiꞌchi rahbi Ñiꞌh loh raꞌ ba: ―Guyuuꞌ tuhbi bwiinn, guyuuꞌ ba lahda tuhbi jwamihyi lasahca, ya biriaꞌh ba gwah ba stuhbi guihdxyi ziitu tin gaca ba rrehyi, ya chin guibiaꞌgarii ba chiꞌchi guinabwaꞌ ba guihdxyi chi.

Ya nnaaru guiriaꞌh ba yihdzi ba, gudihdxyixgah ba tsiꞌh xmooza ba tin gudiꞌhi ba tuhbigah mweeyi nin lasahca guicaꞌha raꞌ ba, chiꞌchi rahbi bwiinn chi loh raꞌ ba: “Gulguiꞌhnnee mweeyi riiꞌ guriꞌxi hasta chin gabiaꞌgariin stuhbi.”
Ya bwiinn lahdxyi ba ayi guclaaꞌdzi raꞌ ba laꞌh ba, niꞌchin guxeꞌhla raꞌ ba paaldaa bwiinn nin zeguihtsi raꞌ: “Ayi xclaaꞌdzi nu gaca ba xrrehyi nu.”
Per nahpa guhca ba rrehyi, chiꞌchi gubiaꞌgarii ba lahdxyi ba. Ya chin gubiaꞌgarii ba, chiꞌchi gudihdxyi ba mooza raꞌ nin basiaꞌhannee ba mweeyi tin gacabwaꞌ ba blaacala cayuhnn raꞌn gahn.
Ya galoh bwiinn nin badiꞌhi ba mweeyi badzihn loh ba, chiꞌchi rahbi mooza chi: “Daada, laꞌxmweeyi luꞌh cayuhnn gahn tsiꞌh bwelta ziga naan.”

Chiꞌchi rahbi rrehyi chi loh ba: “Bwen gahca; yiꞌh naa luꞌh tuhbi mooza bwen pur bwiꞌhnn luꞌh dziꞌn zaꞌca nee gulliaꞌyiꞌhn nin baniꞌhihn. Yannah guniꞌhihn dziꞌn guunn luꞌh, guinabwaꞌ luꞌh tsiꞌh guihdxyi.”
Chiꞌchi badzihn stuhbi mooza loh ba, chiꞌchi rahbi mooza chi: “Daada, xmweeyi luꞌh cayuhnn gahn gaꞌyu bwelta mahzi ziga naan.”
Chiꞌchi rahbi ba loh ba: “Yiꞌh guniꞌhihn dziꞌn guunn luꞌh guinabwaꞌ luꞌh gaꞌyu guihdxyi.”
Chiꞌchi badzihn stuhbi mooza loh ba, chiꞌchi rahbi mooza chi: “Daada, laꞌxmweeyi luꞌh deeꞌ; guluꞌchaꞌyisiñin laꞌn tuhbi baschihn
laasii bidxyihbihn yiꞌh pur naa luꞌh tuhbi bwiinn nadxiipa dxyiꞌdxyi. Racaꞌha luꞌh cohsa raꞌ nin ayi naa xteenn luꞌh, neezaa rataaꞌha luꞌh guiñaꞌh hasta ayi gulahchi luꞌh.”

Chiꞌchi rahbi rrehyi chi loh ba: “¡Mooza xihn mooza dxaaba! Cun sola dxyiꞌdxyi nin guñiꞌ luꞌh ca guꞌnnahn guelguxchiisi yiꞌh. Sidela nnah luꞌh naan tuhbi bwiinn nin nadxiipadxyiꞌdxyi nen nahgahca luꞌh racaꞌhahn nin ayi naa xteꞌnnahn nen nnaaza luꞌh rataaꞌhahn guiñaꞌh nin ayi naaza xteꞌnnahn,
¿xixnaa ayi bagasiaꞌhan luꞌh xmweeꞌyihnca baancu tin chin ñabiaꞌgariin ñacaꞌhañin cun garaa lliiꞌnan?”
Chiꞌchi rahbi ba loh raꞌ nin rii riꞌchi: “Gulgacaꞌha mweeyi ca tin gulgadiꞌhin laꞌh bwiinn nin bwiꞌhnn gahn tsiꞌh taantu mahzi.”
Chiꞌchi rahbi raꞌ ba loh ba: “Daada, per laꞌba nahpala tsiꞌh mweeyi.”
Chiꞌchi rahbilagaꞌh rrehyi chi: “Niꞌchin nin ñaan loh tu, nin nahpa ziahanan niꞌchi gaca guicaꞌharun, ya nin nahpa gulliaꞌhan hasta nin ruhnn ba lligaaba nahpa ba gacaꞌhañin loh ba.
Ya garaa bwiinn nin bidxyiꞌchinee naꞌh nin ayi guclaaꞌdzi ñahcaꞌhn rrehyi loh raꞌ ñiꞌh, gultaꞌnee raꞌ ba riiꞌ tin gadxiinn tu laꞌh raꞌ ba delanta loon.”
Guyuꞌtii Jesuhs laꞌn guihdxyi Jerusalehn ziga tuhbi rrehyi
Ya chin guyaꞌloh bwiiꞌyidxyiꞌdxyi Ñiꞌh dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ chi, chiꞌchi biriaꞌh Ñiꞌh tin zee Ñiꞌh guihdxyi Jerusalehn.
Ya chin zegadzihn Ñiꞌh tuhbi guihdxyi nin laa Betfageh cun guihdxyi nin laa Betania, gahxu loh dahan nin laa Olivo chiꞌchi guxeꞌhla Ñiꞌh chiohpa xpwiinn Ñiꞌh,

chiꞌchi rahbi Ñiꞌh loh raꞌ ba: ―Gulchee loh guihdxyi nin naa gahxuru, ya chin gadzihn tu riꞌchi, chiꞌchi gwaꞌha tu caduꞌh tuhbi buhrra nin nadxyiꞌbi nin nagahdxi gaca nadoꞌtiiꞌ. Gulgaxachi ma tin dxieꞌnee tu ma.
Ya sidela chyuulla guinaꞌbadxyiꞌdxyi loh tu: “¿Xixnaa guxachi tu buhrra ca?”, chiꞌchi gahbi tu loh ba: “Tuhbi bwiinn nin mahzi rnabwaꞌ cachiꞌhn ma tin tsiiba ba ma.”
Ya seguihdu ziaganee raꞌ chiꞌh ba ma, ya zigapaꞌ guñiꞌ Jesuhs guzohba xchiꞌdxyi Ñiꞌh guzahca raꞌ ba.
Ya chin rigaxachi raꞌ ba buhrra chi, chiꞌchi gunabadxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ bwiinn nin naa xteenn ñiꞌh laꞌh ma, rahbi raꞌ ba: ―¿Xixnaa rigaxachi tu buhrra ca?
Chiꞌchi rahbi raꞌ ba: ―Dxugaxachi nu ma laasii tuhbi bwiinn nin mahzi rnabwaꞌ cachiꞌhn ba ma tin tsiiba ba ma.
Chiꞌchi baganee raꞌ ba ma hasta zuu Jesuhs, chiꞌchi badziiꞌba raꞌ ba xahba raꞌ ba dihtsi ma tin guzohba Jesuhs dihtsi ma.
Ya chin zeezah Jesuhs loh neziuh nin zee Jerusalehn, zeedziꞌba Ñiꞌh buhrra chi, chiꞌchi gudxyihxi raꞌ ba xahba raꞌ ba loh neziuh tin gudiiꞌdxinee buhrriꞌhn chi laꞌh Ñiꞌh loh lahdxi raꞌ chi.

Ya chin zegadzihn gahxuru Ñiꞌh loh dahan nin laa Olivo, zenaꞌhla paaldaa bwiinn laꞌh Jesuhs nin riachiistoꞌ Ñiꞌh laꞌh Ñiꞌh, chiꞌchi guzaꞌloh cañiꞌ raꞌ ba jweersi pur jweersirooꞌ nin nahpa Dxiohs. Ziꞌchi cañiꞌ raꞌ ba pur ziahan dziꞌn rooꞌ raꞌ nin bwaꞌha raꞌ ba bwiꞌhnn Jesuhs,

neezaa cañiꞌ raꞌ ba: ―¡Bwiꞌnntaaꞌyi Dxiohs yihca rrehyi nin zeꞌ pura xcweenta Dxiohs; nnah dxyiiriistoꞌ Dxiohs nin nuu dxibaaꞌ laasii nnah laꞌJesuhs zeꞌ tin guinabwaꞌ Ñiꞌh pura xcweenta Dxiohs; yannah gachidiꞌtsi nu zuxchilli Dxiohs pur garaa nin bwiꞌhnn Ñiꞌh!

Ya lahda raꞌ bwiinn chi rii nuhn bwiinn fariseu, ya chin bihn raꞌ ba xi riñiꞌ raꞌ bwiinn chi, chiꞌchi rahbi raꞌ ba loh Jesuhs: ―Mwehsu, guñiꞌ loh raꞌ bwiinn nin zeꞌnaꞌhla yiꞌh tin ayiru guiñiꞌ raꞌ ba ziꞌca.
Chiꞌchi rahbi Jesuhs loh raꞌ ba: ―Sidela laꞌh raꞌ bwiinn riiꞌ cwidxyii raꞌ ba, zibwidxaaꞌyoꞌba dxiah raꞌ nin zaa loh yuh xcweenta raꞌ ba.
Biꞌn Jesuhs pur bwiinn guihdxyi Jerusalehn
Ya chin zegadzihn gahxuru Jesuhs guihdxyi Jerusalehn, chin bwaꞌha Ñiꞌh guihdxyi chi, chiꞌchi guzaꞌloh biꞌn Ñiꞌh pur guihdxyi chi,
chiꞌchi rahbi Ñiꞌh: ―¡Xixlaaxchimmatiiꞌ ayi gaann tu xi cohsa guunn tu tin cwidxyiistoꞌ tu! Per nnah nuulaꞌn cohsa chi par laꞌh tu,
laasii zadzihn dxyih raꞌ chin gadzihn bwiinn raꞌ nin rdxyiꞌchinee laꞌh tu nee zuhnn raꞌ ba ziga tuhbi leeꞌ gadiidxi rwaaꞌ guihdxyi tin ayi gusaaꞌn raꞌ ba guiriaꞌh tu,

nen cun nee chuꞌtii raꞌ ba lahda guihdxyi tin gucwih raꞌ ba garaa yuuꞌ cun garaa muhru nin nuu gadiidxi rwaaꞌ guihdxyi; ziꞌchi gunnee raꞌ ba laꞌh tu pur nin ayi biuꞌnbwaꞌ tu dxyih nin bieꞌguiaꞌha Dxiohs laꞌh tu.
Basiaa Jesuhs laꞌn guidoꞌrooꞌ

Ya chin badzihn Jesuhs loh guihdxyi Jerusalehn, chiꞌchi guyuꞌtii Ñiꞌh laꞌn guidoꞌrooꞌ ya bwaꞌha Ñiꞌh rii raꞌ bwiinn laꞌn guidoꞌ chi nin ruhnn raꞌ guriꞌxi, nee ayi rbwihdxyi-rnaaba raꞌ ba Dxiohs. Chiꞌchi guzohbaloh babweꞌhedxiaꞌhla Ñiꞌh laꞌh raꞌ ba nez dihtsijwehra,

ya gaduhbi cagabweꞌhe Ñiꞌh laꞌh raꞌ ba, chiꞌchi rahbi Ñiꞌh loh raꞌ ba: ―Loh Xchihtsi Dxiohs caa raꞌ dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ riiꞌ: “Yiidzihn gaca tuhbi yuuꞌ hasta dxiꞌ tu tin cwidxyi-guinaaba tu naꞌh”, ¡ya laꞌh tu ruhnn tun zigazi tuhbi cwehva hasta riuuꞌ raꞌ gubaꞌn!

Ya guillii-guillii cagaluuꞌyi Jesuhs laꞌn guidoꞌrooꞌ chi per bwiinn raꞌ nin rnabwaꞌ loh raꞌ bixohza neezaa bwiinn raꞌ nin ruluuꞌyi xlehyi Moisehs, neezaa bwiinnguuhla raꞌ cadxiꞌhyi raꞌ ba mohda tin chiinn raꞌ ba laꞌh Ñiꞌh,
per ayi bidxeela xa ñuhnn raꞌ ban laasii garaa raꞌ bwiinn rigacaꞌdxyiahga dziꞌtsi raꞌ ba xchiꞌdxyi Ñiꞌh.
